issues.detail: The Greek 'εδοξεν' (edoxen) is a passive/impersonal verb meaning 'it seemed' or 'it was considered.' The Vietnamese translation 'đã thấy tốt' (found it good) attributes the action of 'finding/thinking' to 'Thánh Linh và chúng ta' (Holy Spirit and we), making it an active joint action. In Greek, the Holy Spirit is the subject of the judgment/opinion ('it seemed to the Holy Spirit'), not a co-subject with 'us'.
